title: Agro-residential plots, Chegutu
summary: Two-hectare agro-residential plots just 6 km north-east of the Chegutu CBD, easily accessible from the Chegutu to Chinhoyi road.

details.label: Price
details.value: US$2.85/m² cash or US$3/m² on payment terms, before VAT

details.label: Terms of sale
details.value: 30% deposit, balance by 31 December 2026 at a 3% once-off admin fee on the balance; or 30% deposit, balance over 12 months at 12% per annum; or 30% deposit paid over 3 months and the balance over the remaining 9 months at 12% per annum
